description: Shared case table for the lowercase-hex rule of trust-root.md (row 5, section 4.2) and the uncompressed SEC1 public key rule. Every case is applied to a signature or key produced at test time with an ephemeral key; no signature or key is stored here. Mutations, applied to a 128-character signature `sig` whose r and s halves each start with '0': none = sig; z128 = 128 'z'; upper = sig.upper(); space_padded = ' ' + sig[1:64] + ' ' + sig[65:]; zero_x_prefixed = '0x' + sig[2:64] + '0x' + sig[66:]; underscored = sig[1] + '_' + sig[2:64] + sig[65] + '_' + sig[66:]; truncated_127 = sig[:127]; extended_129 = sig + '0'; empty = ''; non_string = the integer 12345. The uppercase, space-padded and underscored forms denote the same r and s under int(x, 16); the 0x-prefixed form parses too, to different integers. Public key mutations, applied to a lowercase uncompressed key `pub`: none = pub; upper = '04' + pub[2:].upper(); leading_space = ' ' + pub; trailing_newline = pub + '\n'. `pinned` false means the signature names a key_id no pinned root carries: row 5 is evaluated before row 6, so the status is still MALFORMED_SIGNATURE.
